intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Someone has pinned up a hand-lettered notice: *PLEASE DO NOT TUOCH.*

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Tavri opens her mouth. Her ears go up. Then she closes it again.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I had a joke about that. A good one.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I’m going to look at the sign instead. Just look at it. Like a tourist.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “You say that as if leisure were legal.”

options.labelText: “I’ll look at it with you. Carefully. No tuoching.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Look at us. Two grown adults, not tuoching.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You look at it together until someone comes along and fixes the spelling.

options.labelText: “Aw, go on. What was the joke?”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She tells it. It’s very good, and you laugh. When she looks back, it’s only a sign again.
